summary: Social Spotlight page redesign - All 15 features tested and verified. The new horizontal school filter pills design is working correctly. Video filtering, Women's Only toggle, Refresh button, empty state, and video cards all functioning as expected.

issues: Minor: Some thumbnails appear black due to YouTube thumbnail caching - this is expected behavior as noted by main agent

passed_tests: Page loads at /spotlight route with data-testid='social-spotlight'
Page displays title 'Social Spotlight' and subtitle 'Latest volleyball content from your pipeline'
Horizontal school filter bar visible with data-testid='school-filter-bar'
'All Schools' pill selected by default (dark background style)
Clicking UCLA filter pill shows '7 videos from UCLA' text
Clicking same school pill deselects it and shows all videos
Clicking 'All Schools' pill resets the filter
Video count displays '7 videos' by default
Video cards display title, university name, and timestamp
Video cards link to YouTube with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'
UCLA school pill shows count badge of '7'
Empty state shows when school with no videos selected (Stanford)
Clear filters button appears in empty state (data-testid='clear-filters-btn')
Sidebar navigation shows Social Spotlight as active (font-weight: 600)
HTML entities properly decoded in video titles (decodeHtml function working)
critical_code_review_comments: Well-structured component with proper separation (VideoCard, SchoolFilter, LockedOverlay, FeedSkeleton)
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
HTML entity decoding implemented correctly via decodeHtml function
Full-width design uses max-w-6xl mx-auto (no sidebars on content area)
Proper security attributes on video links (target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer')
Beach volleyball content correctly filtered out via BEACH_FILTER regex
seed_data_creation: None - used existing pipeline data with UCLA videos
context_for_next_testing_agent: Social Spotlight page redesigned from sidebar-based layout to horizontal pill filters. API endpoint unchanged at /api/social-spotlight/feed. Demo user has Pro tier access so live feed is visible. UCLA has 7 videos from their YouTube channel. Other schools like Stanford show empty state (no videos). Test credentials: demo@capymatch.com / demo2026. All data-testid attributes: social-spotlight, school-filter-bar, filter-all-schools, school-filter-{program_id}, filter-scroll-left/right, vb-only-toggle, spotlight-refresh, video-grid, video-card-{video_id}, empty-feed, clear-filters-btn, spotlight-loading, live-feed-upgrade-btn (for locked state).
